title: MemoryReadResult
description: Direct Memory Envelope, one authorized immutable enumeration page, a confirmation_required result of a gated op (memory.supersede / memory.pin / memory.unpin / memory.restore / memory.archive / memory.unarchive / memory.correct / memory.confirm / memory.reject / memory.bind / memory.unbind / memory.note_put's replacement — the same closed set as ConfirmationRequired.operation), a superseded result, or a pin/unpin/bind/unbind binding result. The catalog resolves the embedded canonical Envelope without network access. memory.get's completeness counts are INTENTIONALLY absent, not unimplemented (ADR-0041 D-D, card 22): the route always answers class=cannot_establish / reason=count_unknown with exact and known_lower_bound null, because classify() maps a DirectGet to QueryClass::Exact and §22.0 makes an exact class without a predicate_id/census a hard 5xx — filling the five counts without a census would turn a correct 200 into a 500. The unlock is a separate decision: a universe-of-one census for DirectGet. memory.enumerate, which does carry a census, answers exact.

ConfirmationRequired.description: §33.10 rule 9 / ADR-0018 first call of a gated destructive op: the server minted a single-use confirm_token bound to (tenant,user,operation,target,successor); nothing else was written.

target.description: The tuple the token is bound to. memory.note_put (ADR-0067 D-J replacement) names the head it supersedes (memory_id) and its note_id; the token also binds the whole replacement intent digest. memory.bind / memory.unbind bind the PAIR (memory_id, task_id) — §25.4.A(7)/(8): a confirmation for binding S to task T must not execute a bind of S to task U, so the task rides the token's successor leg exactly as memory.supersede's replacement does.

BindingWritten.description: memory.pin / memory.unpin / memory.bind / memory.unbind executed (§36, ADR-0019; card 22b ADR-0045 added the MANDATORY/TASK pair). binding_id is the private.context_bindings row. mode says which lane the row belongs to: PINNED at the credential's WORKSPACE scope (pin/unpin), MANDATORY at the authenticated TASK scope (bind/unbind). pin/bind: inserted=false when the binding already existed (D-C idempotent, no new row). unpin/unbind: the row's revoked_at is set; Evidence/Memory untouched. scope names the authorization scope the binding was written under (D-E, card 13). This is ONE branch, not four: the four ops differ only in mode, scope kind and state, so widening the three closed sets is the whole change and the output union stays at 15 branches. card 22c (ADR-0046): bind also reports purpose and task_authorization — whether this call wrote a private.task_binding_grants row. Both are absent on pin/unpin/unbind. Still ONE branch: the output union stays at 15.

scope.description: §36/ADR-0035 (card 13, D-E) + §25.4.A(7): the binding's authorization scope — the credential's WORKSPACE route for pin/unpin, the authenticated TASK for bind/unbind.

purpose.description: memory.bind only: the purpose this binding was written under.

task_authorization.description: memory.bind only: granted = a task authorization was written in this transaction (purpose ADOPT_TASK_INSTRUCTION); none = the binding exists with no authorization, and the obligation is reported as MISSING_TASK_AUTHORIZATION at read time.

Restored.description: memory.restore executed (§36/ADR-0020): target is status=active again with superseded_by cleared; a NEW MEMORY_LIFECYCLE ticket was issued (new stream_seq — the old TOMBSTONED/consumed row is never revived), and consistency_token is bound to that new seq (§15.5).

ConflictReason.description: A refused governance op surfaced as a success-shaped CONFLICT with a sub-reason (ADR-0020 D-B): ErrorCode stays frozen at 18 (§52.1), so the u16 reason and its SCREAMING_SNAKE label ride here instead of a 19th ErrorCode. memory.restore uses 1001 UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED, 1002 TARGET_NOT_CURRENT, 1003 ERASE_TERMINAL, 1004 TARGET_ADVANCED, 1201 ALREADY_IN_STATE, 1202 NOT_REVERSIBLE.

ArchiveChanged.description: memory.archive / memory.unarchive executed (§36/ADR-0024, Q3): archive set private.memory_records.archived_at (the memory is now hidden from recall/context/enumerate, still returned by memory.get); unarchive cleared it. NOT a status transition — G59-4 is untouched. One MEMORY_LIFECYCLE ticket was issued (new stream_seq) so the projection worker can refresh the point payload. Exactly one of archived_at / unarchived_at is present.

Superseded.description: memory.supersede executed (§36): target now status=superseded with superseded_by=replacement_memory_id; one MEMORY_LIFECYCLE ticket was issued on the workspace projection stream (§15.7).

Corrected.description: memory.correct executed (§Q4/ADR-0025): a user correction. One transaction inserted a new DirectUserInput Evidence (evidence_id) and a new active Memory version (memory_id), linked the original (superseded) to it via superseded_by, and appended a SUPERSEDE lifecycle event (reason USER_CORRECTION) that is itself restorable via memory.restore within the undo window. The original Evidence body is never edited in place. consistency_token is bound to the new stream_seq (§15.5).

subject_ids.description: §6.1.3 (ADR-0028): every subject the new version is linked to — inherited from the original (INHERITED) plus any explicit subject_ids/subject_keys the call declared.

affect_ids.description: §8.5.1 (ADR-0030 D-E): the affect rows appended to the new version from the call's `affects` (empty when none were supplied).

Confirmed.description: memory.confirm executed (§36/§10.1/ADR-0026, Card 6): one transaction promoted a distill_candidates row into a new UserConfirmed Evidence (evidence_id) + a new active Memory (memory_id), marked the candidate CONFIRMED naming that memory, and issued one MEMORY_LIFECYCLE ticket. consistency_token is bound to the new stream_seq (§15.5).

subject_ids.description: §6.1.3 (ADR-0028): every subject the confirmed memory is linked to — the source Evidence's own declaration (carried onto the UserConfirmed Evidence) plus any explicit subject_ids/subject_keys the call declared.

Rejected.description: memory.reject executed (§36/ADR-0026, Card 6): the pending candidate is now REJECTED; no Evidence/Memory written.

CandidatesPage.description: memory.enumerate {candidates:true} (ADR-0026, Card 6 D-E): the tenant's PENDING distill candidates visible to the caller, newest first. Read-only.

Subject.description: One registered subject (§6.1.3, ADR-0028): the item shape of memory.enumerate {subjects:true} and the whole result of memory.subject_register / memory.subject_link_key (D-F).

AffectAnnotated.description: memory.annotate_affect executed (§8.5.1, ADR-0030 D-C): the immutable affect rows appended to memory_id and the MEMORY_LIFECYCLE re-projection ticket (stream_seq/commit_seq) issued on the memory's stream so the Qdrant point picks up the affect payload.

SubjectsPage.description: memory.enumerate {subjects:true} (§6.1.3, ADR-0028, card 8): the caller's tenant's registered subjects (live heads only), newest first, with their external keys and roles. Read-only; another tenant's registry is absent under RLS, never filtered in application code.

NoteStored.description: memory.note_put executed (ADR-0067 D-A): ONE PostgreSQL transaction committed the idempotency receipt, a MANUAL_NOTE Evidence (origin AuthenticatedAgent), the identity contract and the authorised Memory with its PRIMARY evidence link, the stream/outbox events and this locally signed consistency_token. memory_id is a real, readable Memory (status stored). Indexing (embedding, Qdrant) follows the commit through the outbox and is never awaited (indexing scheduled). A replay of the same idempotency_key returns the original ids. note_id names the note (ADR-0067 D-J: a create's note_id is its own memory_id); a confirmed replacement also echoes supersedes, the version it superseded.

indexing.description: scheduled: the outbox indexes the note after the commit (never awaited); excluded: data_class SECRET_MATERIAL, which §18.2 never cards or embeds — no recall leg will ever exist for this note.

AuthorityCeilingExceeded.description: memory.note_put business refusal (ADR-0067 D-C), returned with isError=true: the requested AuthorityClass exceeds the server-fixed origin's ceiling. Nothing was stored (no Evidence, Memory, candidate or accepted outbox row). This is a result shape, not a 19th ErrorCode (§52.1 stays closed at 18).

GrepPage.description: memory.grep (ADR-0069): one keyset page of matching lines with ±1 line of context. total = total_matching_lines over the caller's whole view in one snapshot (never an estimate); truncated means this response did not carry the rest, and next_cursor continues it.

StaleNoteVersion.description: memory.note_put replacement business refusal (ADR-0067 D-J), returned with isError=true: supersedes is not the note's current head (another replacement won). Nothing was written and no token was minted or consumed. It names no head id. A result shape, not a 19th ErrorCode (§52.1 stays closed at 18).
